description.value: Woo Korean BBQ is a table-grill Korean BBQ restaurant in South Surrey emphasizing fresh premium Canadian meats alongside seafood and traditional Korean dishes. It bills itself as Greater Vancouver's best Korean BBQ spot and offers a broad menu ranging from beef BBQ courses to dolsot bibimbap and stews. A touring cyclist stopping here would find a sit-down, full-service meal suited to refuelling after a long ride.
